McDowell saw the bodies in person. He was joined by Jim Caruso, the chief medical examiner for Denver and a forensic pathologist.

as_told.title: McDowell and Caruso examine the bodies in person

plain: John McDowell, a man who says he examined them himself, says that in the 2020s he looked at a set of small three-fingered bodies found in Peru. He says there is data suggesting some of them might once have been living creatures, which would mean they are not simply made objects. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, adds that McDowell saw the bodies in person and was joined by Jim Caruso, the chief medical examiner for Denver and a forensic pathologist, a doctor who studies bodies to find out how people died.
